title: Pure Hecahands
summary: Hecahands cards with generic staples. Hecahands is an Illusion Fusion strategy whose Main Deck monsters deploy when the opponent adds cards to their hand and steal monsters from the opponent's hand, Deck, field, Extra Deck, and GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Hidden Hecahands searches a Hecahands monster and Sets a Hecahands Spell/Trap directly from the Deck, and from the GY forces the opponent to draw and discard (triggering the Level 7 Hecahands).
Hecahands Ibtel reveals and shuffles itself from the hand into the Deck to Special Summon a Hecahands from the Deck, and revives a Hecahands when sent to the GY.
Hecahands Yadel reveals and shuffles itself back to search a Hecahands Spell/Trap, and Sets one from the GY when sent there.

summary.title: Opening: The Hidden Hecahands or Ibtel + Mankibuel
steps: Activate The Hidden Hecahands to search Hecahands Ibtel and Set Ib'al-Hecahands or Yad'al-Hecahands.
Reveal and shuffle Hecahands Ibtel into the Deck to Special Summon a Hecahands monster from the Deck.
Reveal Hecahands Mankibuel in the hand to Fusion Summon Hecahands Jauzah or Hecahands Dandalos, then search another Hecahands card with Jauzah.

summary.title: Theft & Illusion Mechanic
summary.text: None of the Hecahands monsters can be destroyed by battle, nor can monsters they battle. Whenever the opponent adds a card to their hand, the Level 7 Hecahands Special Summon themselves from the hand: Hecahands Breus summons a monster from their hand to your field, Hecahands Gaigas excavates 3 cards of their Deck to summon one, and Hecahands Godos revives a monster from their GY on their turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Hecahands Dandalos takes control of an opponent's monster every turn and lets your Fusion Monsters and stolen monsters attack directly.
Hecahands Jauzah (summoned via Fusion or by Tributing an Illusion and a stolen monster) searches a Hecahands card every turn.
Hecahands Xeno summons a monster directly from the opponent's Extra Deck to your field, and steals their monsters if destroyed.

Ib'al-Hecahands negates a monster effect and summons that monster to your field, Yad'al-Hecahands negates a Spell/Trap and Sets it to your field, and Hecahands Bait Tributes a Hecahands or stolen monster to steal an opponent's monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Chimera, Azamina, and Relinquished hybrids are left out to keep the deck pure Hecahands. Note that the page refers to Hecahands Mankibuel as Makibel.
